notes: Settings, WiFi password included, now survive flashing a new build over USB
The printer setup, the voice key and the tour come back after a USB flash too
The music note shows on the home screen as well as the game screen, from the first song until restart
The music note is bigger and easier to see: bright while playing, dim when paused or stopped
MOMIR always draws from the card library, even after the emblems or another library was opened
MOMIR matches Creature in any case and logs what the library holds when it finds none
